text: Did pirates really make you walk the plank?
A plank, a sword, a shark. Just like the stories!
Pirates wanted loot, not a fight.
So their black flag was meant to scare a crew into giving up.
And they had rules. Lose a limb in battle, and the crew paid you eight hundred pieces of eight.
Cheat the crew, and you were left on an empty island.
But the plank? Almost never recorded. Unwanted men simply went over the side.
The plank comes from stories, like Treasure Island and Peter Pan.
